rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a particular memory or a person, event, or thing remembered.

example.english: This photo brings back that remembrance.
example.traditional: 呢張相令我諗起嗰段回憶。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 ling6 ngo5 nam2 hei2 go2 dyun6 wui4 jik1

rows.note: Choose this for the general mental store or state of remembering rather than one particular recollection.

example.english: I have little remembrance of what happened that night.
example.traditional: 我對嗰晚發生嘅事冇乜記憶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 go2 maan5 faat3 sang1 ge3 si6 mou5 mat1 gei3 jik1

rows.note: Choose this when the remembrance is a physical keepsake or souvenir kept to remind someone of a person or event.

example.english: I bought my mum a remembrance from the trip.
example.traditional: 我喺旅行嗰陣買咗個紀念品畀阿媽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 leoi5 hang4 go2 zan6 maai5 zo2 go3 gei2 nim6 ban2 bei2 aa3 maa1
